items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: I was thinking the New Orleans men would be able to teach in this respect from demonstration... That's what you would need a man on the job for to be a New Orleans man to come in and help you.

ctx.x: Well, how do they crack it? Now, explain that again. In the middle of a phrase?

No, at the end, at the end. It's by emphasizing the vibrato, I always think of the vibrato in terms of wavelength. Up and down wavelength and getting more frequent as you get toward the end of a phrase. Kind of shake, either shaking a horn or using your chops and a trombone man the same way. Yeah, a trombone man uses a vibrato like Jim.
Yeah, but he uses slide partly some of them.
